name: infallible
description: Agent personas for usability-testing insulin pumps against MAUDE failure modes.

scripts.bootstrap: uv sync && pnpm install && uv run pre-commit install
scripts.contracts:gen: uv run python -m infallible_contracts.export_schema packages/contracts-ts/schema/contracts.schema.json && pnpm --filter @infallible/contracts generate
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:py && pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:rs
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:rs: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/visualizer/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/visualizer/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && prettier --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/visualizer/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.prepush:ts: pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test
